deadline.value: Priority deadline for PhD applications is February 1.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The fetched pages do not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The fetched pages do not state PhD funding.

entry_route.value: The fetched pages do not state the degree prerequisite.

app_fee.value: Applications go through SOPHAS, which charges $150 for the first program applied to; the School adds no supplemental fee.
app_fee.quote: SOPHAS charges $150 for the first program you apply to

fee_waiver.value: The School cannot waive the fee, but applicants can ask SOPHAS for financial, service-based or international-based waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: The School of Public Health is not able to offer application fee waivers, but applicants are able to request fee waivers directly from SOPHAS

gre_general.value: The GRE is recommended but not required; MCAT, DAT, GMAT or LSAT scores can be substituted.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is recommended but not required

toefl_min.value: The SOPHAS guide asks for 80 on the internet-based TOEFL, which differs from the Graduate School's new-scale minimum.
toefl_min.quote: 80 or higher on the internet-based test

notes: Biostatistics concentration of the Epidemiology and Biostatistics PhD. Applications go through SOPHAS, not the Graduate School portal, so the SPH values override the university record. The SPH epidemiology page still shows COVID-era GRE and TOEFL text; the 2026 SOPHAS guide was used for current rules. Epidemiology is not a field in the Atlas.
name: Epidemiology and Biostatistics (PhD), Biostatistics
